requiredFindings.title: The production entry still permits bypassing the admitted-boundary requirement
requiredFindings.finding: discover_units is compiled in production with Option<&AdmittedBoundaries>, and None takes the standalone lane successfully. assign_membership and unit_scope_descriptor expose the same production optional input. No require_admitted_boundaries operational entry or test-only gating separates this lane. The opaque security type prevents forgery of a Some value but does not prevent a host composition from dropping the inventory entirely, contrary to NE U-8 and plan r2 section 2.1. The native.admitted-boundaries-required refusal is not implemented.
requiredFindings.requiredChange: Expose production entry points requiring &AdmittedBoundaries (or a checked operational wrapper that refuses absence with the selected internal key). Keep optional/None standalone entry points private behind the existing test/scenario seam. Add a control showing production composition cannot silently take the standalone lane.

requiredFindings.title: String bounds use UTF-8 bytes instead of the selected schema character bounds
requiredFindings.finding: canonical_relative_dir uses path.len() <= 4096, and unit_scope_descriptor similarly checks t.len() > 4096. Rust str::len counts bytes; the selected Python/schema maxLength counts Unicode characters. A root of 2049 NFC e-acute characters is 4098 UTF-8 bytes but is accepted by the bound reference for root admission, membership and scope; this candidate rejects it. The same mismatch occurs for a valid non-ASCII exclusion prefix and in scenario V3 admission length checks. All recorded vector inputs are ASCII, so existing comparisons do not cover it.
requiredFindings.requiredChange: Match the selected character-count bounds at each new schema-equivalent string guard, including scope text and scenario admission, without silently narrowing to a byte limit. Add positive and negative multibyte vectors around the declared bounds and preserve exact reference outcomes.

requiredFindings.title: Default selection omits admission of its own generated request modes
requiredFindings.finding: With a discovered unit copied except languageMode="unknown-mode" and an empty registry, the bound reference refuses native.requested-capability-mode-unregistered:calls:unknown-mode. Candidate selection treats every missing matrix cell as selected, emits requests for the unknown mode, checks only duplicate ownership/cardinality and returns success. WorkspaceUnit.language_mode is an unrestricted String, so the input is representable. Deferring external-spec admission does not establish that internally generated defaults are vocabulary-closed.
requiredFindings.requiredChange: Validate the defaulted rows or their unit modes against the selected matrix and return the reference refusal for an unknown mode before returning an analysisSpec. Keep external full-spec admission deferred as intended, and add a recorded negative vector for this branch.
